verdict.summary: All six available model finals give defensible no-change decisions, cover reuse, quality and efficiency, preserve the safety guard and protected proof, and distinguish historical evidence from unperformed verification. Their unchanged candidates pass the parent-mediated syntax and HTTP proof checks. Original B1 remains an infrastructure failure; B1-retry1 is separate. This does not demonstrate an applied simplification, autonomous execution or a B-arm quality advantage.

defects.issue: The retry artifact embeds the original B1 identifier.
defects.impact: A consumer using only the embedded field could conflate the successful retry with the failed original attempt.
defects.disposition: Nonblocking because immutable external receipts, session identity, artifact hashes and admission explicitly distinguish both attempts. Preserve original content and carry the retry identity in reporting.

defects.issue: The seam's success message includes no new reachable commit, but its assertions do not inspect Git history.
defects.impact: That phrase must not be used as commit-preservation evidence. The parent TAP logs do not expose it on success, and the six model responses do not rely on it.
defects.disposition: Existing frozen fixture limitation; leave frozen bytes unchanged and avoid extending the proof claim.

comparison.baseline_identity: A is the frozen preoptimization spec-first arm, not a direct upstream CE execution.
comparison.model_outcome: Three A finals and three B finals including the distinct retry all reach defensible no-change conclusions. There is no observed model decision advantage for B.
comparison.source_improvement: B explicitly separates proof context from mutation scope, protects tests and test-only seams, requires identity comparison and proof reruns, clarifies caller-owned closeout and report-only authority, and strengthens provider/serialization/comment constraints. These integrate coherently with the original three-lens behavior-preserving intent.
comparison.ce_integration_judgment: The useful three-lens structure, safety invariant and resistance to cosmetic abstraction are retained. B adds engineering evidence and ownership boundaries without adding a default fourth reviewer or broadening mutation scope.
comparison.measurement_limit: The exact request independently instructs both arms to preserve proof and abstain when appropriate; the small already-readable fixture produces a ceiling result. Timings are bounded completion observations, not a controlled speed or quality benefit.

optimization_recommendation.product_source: Retain the current B proof-protection and caller-ownership integration. This evidence does not justify further skill prose expansion or mandatory code churn.
optimization_recommendation.acceptance_reporting: Record six bounded no-change passes, six parent proof passes, one separate original infrastructure failure, no applied simplification, and partial full coverage.
optimization_recommendation.future_evidence: Use a separately pinned successor fixture with a worthwhile equivalent production refactor and tempting protected-test/seam cleanup. Preserve these frozen results. Include caller return and final-tree proof after an actual edit.

full_frozen_missing_facets: No actual model-proposed production replacement occurred, so preservation across a substantive simplification remains unexercised.
No autonomous mutation, save, proof execution or caller handoff was tested; the parent copied unchanged source and executed the fixed proof.
The selected HTTP proof does not cover every response body, exact successful POST status, content-type, fallback route, JSON null, empty body or chunk-boundary serialization behavior.

The runner records the admitted production hash but excludes production source from its post-run hash map. Current unchanged candidates are source-reviewed and benign; this does not establish final production identity for arbitrary future executable replacements.
Serving model identity is unauthenticated, read-only behavior is observed rather than enforced isolation, and the fixture establishes no field outcome or B-arm causal quality gain.
